raw_context: high as fuck 'si naka-carts — from 'Drugs in tha Club' (O Side Mafia feat. Tu$ Brother$); being in a state of intoxication from THC vape cartridges
kasama gang at eabab — from 'Drugs in tha Club'; back slang (tadbalik) for 'babae' (woman/girl), syllables reversed
Iwas ka sa tus — from 'Lulong' (Tu$ Brother$); means getting caught doing something illegal or immoral; the group named themselves after this term
Sagad sa alak — from 'Drugs in tha Club'; means maxed out, going all the way, fully immersed in something (often alcohol/substances)
Matik na sa tropa; matik wasak na agad — from 'Drugs in tha Club'; means automatic/inevitable, will definitely happen, certain result
napapraning — from 'CBR' (Tu$ Brother$); becoming paranoid/extremely anxious, often from substance use or stress; verb form of 'praning'
nakuha ng bisyo — from 'CBR'; vice or addictive habit, especially substance abuse; used to describe being consumed by bad habits
Itago mo sa lonta — from 'Lulong' (Tu$ Brother$); a hiding spot, usually referring to a pocket or concealed place
Marupok ang bilog niyong mundo — from 'Lulong'; literally brittle/fragile; used to mean emotionally weak, easily broken by love or hardship
Na parang nabagantsa — from 'Lulong'; means humiliated, disrespected, made to feel low/small
Umiwas ka tol — from 'Lulong'; casual address for a close friend, buddy; shortened from 'utol' (sibling) used for any close companion
kasi 'lam mo na kalat — from 'Drugs in tha Club'; literally 'scattered/messy'; used to describe something/someone widespread, or behavior that's all over the place
pero di yon umubra — from 'Drugs in tha Club'; to work/be effective; something that achieved its intended result
title track 'Lulong' by Tu$ Brother$ (2023); means fallen/addicted, deeply hooked on something (love, substances, habit); standard Tagalog word repopularized by youth through this track
